audit_method_note: An initial exact second-request replay assertion used JSON-loaded archived feedback key order and failed. That was a reviewer reconstruction error: the request embeds JSON text in workspace.act insertion order while feedback.json is separately written sorted. Rebuilding the actual accepted source order resolves the assertion; both second-request bytes and decoded feedback semantics then match exactly. It is not an implementation finding.

limits_and_remaining_boundaries: The GitHub API association and six green workflow conclusions were supplied by Root, not personally fetched/authenticated. Local digest equality binds this checked ZIP to that supplied digest only.

The ZIP does not contain staged task ancestor trees, public caches, toolchain or real comparator/Landrun/exporter binaries. Their receipt inventory/pins/source hashes are internally consistent, but their bytes, builds and executable correspondence cannot be independently reconstructed from this archive. No nonexistent artifact is invented.

The five native invalid filesystem inputs and the deliberately failing launcher itself are not retained as executable objects here; their raw verifier reports/causes and unchanged fixture source are checked. No host recreation/execution was attempted.

The raw archive seals one final per accepted repair trajectory. A separate raw rejected-second-submit request is not archived; broader rejection/immutability behavior rests on the unchanged accepted implementation and prior trusted regression evidence, not a fabricated native record.

diagnostic_bytes limits aggregate supervisor-captured/stored diagnostic data, not arbitrary internal Lean/Lake/exported-proof buffers. Internal work remains subject to the existing memory/wall budgets. The later buffered flood genuinely reaches the comparator-kind cap but is not an unlimited-generation or exhaustive hostile-code guarantee.

Public-dev reference/scripted sources can be known, and feedback can expose readable public container data. No private-family, held-out, enforced closed-book, retrieval-isolation, calibration or model-performance conclusion follows.

Native evidence supports the scoped fixed-target experimental CLI under trusted quiescent operator/cache assumptions. Arbitrary Lean, malicious concurrent operators, exhaustive kernel/OS/compiler security, provider endpoint/identity/spending/retry behavior and real-model correctness remain outside this acceptance.
No authorized real-provider trial occurred. No model score, VERIFIED theorem/source status, main merge/site readiness or whole Bench Goal completion is conferred.
